# INAS Documentation

> Official Japanese documentation for selecting and purchasing hardware, installing a Raspberry Pi Hub, wiring devices, configuring networks, operating, and troubleshooting the open-source INAS smart cultivation system.

## Start here

- [System overview](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/start/overview/): what runs on Raspberry Pi, ESP32S3, and Cloudflare
- [Choose an installation route](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/start/choose-path/): self-procured hardware or pending company-provided hardware
- [Select and purchase hardware](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/start/hardware/): provisional minimum and recommended Raspberry Pi configurations
- [Pre-purchase checklist](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/start/prerequisites/): site, power, network, and irrigation load checks
- [Network design](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/start/network/): mDNS, reserved IP, MQTT, OTA, and Cloudflare boundaries
- [Self-procured setup journey](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/start/quickstart/): purchase through field acceptance
- [Company-provided hardware](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/start/provided-hardware/): pending planned setup flow, not a current product specification
- [Safety](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/start/safety/): electrical, water, and software safety

## Hub

- [Prepare Raspberry Pi](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/hub/raspberry-pi/): Raspberry Pi OS, hostname, Avahi, DHCP reservation, and Mosquitto
- [Install the Hub](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/hub/install/)
- [Cloudflare Access and Tunnel](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/hub/cloudflare/)
- [Update and backup](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/hub/update-backup/)

## Devices

- [Device catalog](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/devices/)
- [WTR single-channel watering device](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/devices/wtr/): soil A2/D2, irrigation D4
- [WRS RS485 watering device](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/devices/wrs/)
- [SOI and ENV sensors](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/devices/sensors/)

## Configuration and operations

- [Watering settings](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/configure/watering/)
- [Settings reference](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/configure/settings-reference/)
- [Firmware and OTA](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/operate/firmware/)
- [Runtime Config](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/reference/runtime-config/)

## Troubleshooting and support

- [Troubleshooting index](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/troubleshoot/)
- [Device offline](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/troubleshoot/device-offline/)
- [Watering does not start](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/troubleshoot/watering/)
- [Runtime Config is not applied](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/troubleshoot/config/)
- [Discord Community](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/community/)

The current actionable installation route is self-procured hardware. The formal Hub hardware specification and company-provided hardware are pending. Raspberry Pi mDNS is available to management PCs, but current device firmware does not issue an explicit mDNS query; use the Hub DHCP-reserved IP for device MQTT and OTA until that capability is implemented and accepted. Detailed source-level specifications are maintained in the INAS repository. Never disclose credentials, private hostnames, or production device identifiers when requesting support.
